<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/gtactwpsp/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)">

**Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)** adds control remapping, an optional third-person camera, and radio and mission options for the game.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#gtactwpsp) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/GTACTW.PPSSPP.FusionFix/main.c) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/GTACTW.PPSSPP.FusionFix/memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/GTACTW.PPSSPP.FusionFix/GTACTW.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Options

- **Vehicle controls** — Swap R-button/Cross and L-button/Square in vehicles. Use the emulator settings to swap these buttons with triggers and drive using triggers.
- **On-foot controls** — Swap R-button/Circle on foot. Requires `SwapDrivingControls`.
- **Third-person camera** — Enable a third-person camera. Press DPAD-RIGHT to switch between cameras. Use the Right Stick to adjust position and angle. The original cinematic camera will be disabled.
- **Radio** — Enable the radio in emergency vehicles.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.
- **Xin missions** — Unlock Xin missions in the replay board. The INI warns that this can cause bugs; use it after completing the other missions.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/GTACTW.PPSSPP.FusionFix/GTACTW.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game in PPSSPP.
